services.desc: At Skydive Vancouver Island, your Instructor will assist you each step of the way on your first Solo Skydive! The first jump course is designed for people who are curious about skydiving, have maybe already gone for a Tandem Skydive, and are ready to go Solo out of the plane! In this structured one day camp, our team will lead you through the technical & equipment knowledge, the practical skills, and the safety components. Then you will experience a Solo Skydive from 4,000 feet! This includes five (5) hours of ground training consisting of an introduction to skydiving, technical & equipment training, in-flight procedures, exiting the aircraft, and safety procedures.
